mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 5.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by > 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling a supply chain rebound, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO > 6mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by > 1% QoQ, indicating reduced demand, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate decreased corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances when GDPC1 declines > 1% QoQ, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 1.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below its 3-month moving average, the combined signal of tight monetary policy and low inflation leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by > 0.5% in two consecutive months, signaling labor market weakness, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A steady increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months, indicating sustained demand, always leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate continued economic growth.
evidence_refs: fact:historical retail sales and economic growth correlations
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
